claims.scope: If A has at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least L and any invertible original-coordinate 2x2 principal block B has sigma_min(B)>=L/64, then the full quadratic form has essential density <619/L for arbitrary independent cap-one inputs and arbitrary complementary spectrum/affine terms. Definite B gives <202/L. Continuity not claimed.

In the fleet03/B08 common-plane state, with b=s1(B)/L, epsilon=sigma_min(B)/L and nu=||N||_F/L for the exact pair-Schur cross block, the completed rank-free first-compound theorem gives ||p_Q||inf<=15.829(b epsilon^2 nu)^(-1/4)L^-1. Hence the 619/L benchmark is paid whenever b epsilon^2 nu>=4.28e-7.
Under C=M1^T R_c M2+T and P1TP2=0, the exact post-pair crossing N=M1^T(R_c-B^-1)M2+T satisfies ||N||_F^2=||M1^T(R_c-B^-1)M2||_F^2+||T||_F^2.

Explicit Hadamard family A_(m,epsilon) with exact spectrum {epsilon+2/epsilon,-(epsilon+2/epsilon),1}, robust common-plane arm areas 1, exact Schur match N=0, and for epsilon<1/64 and sufficiently large m every physical 2x2 principal block has sigma_min<1/64. The fixed e5f Theorem F nevertheless gives continuous density <=12(epsilon+2/epsilon)^(-2/3). This is not a QFORM counterexample.

not_claimed: No unrestricted QFORM solution or counterexample.
No continuity conclusion for the 619/L physical-pair gate or the rank-free pair-Schur branch.
No deletion of small operator tails under arbitrary unbounded product inputs.
No assertion that the exact-match stress family exhausts the remaining near-singular chamber.
